headlines.title: Out-of-control wildfires burn in Europe as millions brace for severe weather in the U.S.
headlines.description: Millions of people across the U.S. are on alert for severe storms on Sunday as crews in Europe rushed to put out wildfires that are burning out of control. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Bryan Kohberger seeks to take back guilty plea
headlines.description: Bryan Kohberger, the man convicted of killing four University of Idaho students in 2022, is seeking to abandon his guilty plea. NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris explains how a post-conviction challenge works in the court system.

headlines.title: Mitch McConnell releases health update, saying he’s not ready to return to work yet
headlines.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell’s office released a health update Monday, saying he’s still not ready to return to in-person work after his June 14 hospitalization.

headlines.title: Shooting at Seattle Food Festival Leaves at Least 3 Dead
headlines.description: At least three people were killed and four others were injured when a gunman opened fire at a popular food festival near the Space Needle in Seattle Sunday night. One suspect is in custody another is being sought after fleeing the scene. NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Video helps free man from death row
headlines.description: A Louisiana man was recently released after nearly three decades on death row for a murder multiple judges now agree never happened. Jimmie Duncan won his freedom with the help of a video that the jury did not see in his trial. NBC News’ Dan Slepian reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Bryan Kohberger files a petition to challenge his guilty plea and conviction
headlines.description: Bryan Kohberger, the man convicted of killing four University of Idaho students in 2022, is seeking to abandon his guilty plea and wants his day in court.

headlines.title: Trump, Congress and world leaders to honor the late Sen. Lindsey Graham in Washington
headlines.description: World leaders, President Donald Trump and officials in Washington will pay their respects in funeral services for Republican Sen. Republican Sen. Lindsey Graham.

headlines.title: Citing ‘common sense,’ James Comey’s team urges judge to toss seashells case
headlines.description: Attorneys for James Comey have asked a federal judge to dismiss the seashells-based prosecution of the former FBI director.

headlines.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell’s office released a health update Monday, saying he’s still not ready to return to in-person work after his June 14 hospitalization.

headlines.title: Wife of Kansas City Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy allegedly shot by their son
headlines.description: The wife of Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy was shot on Sunday night in Northern Virginia, allegedly by their son, authorities said.

headlines.title: Secret Service agent charged in near-fatal hazing that led to victim’s kidney failure
headlines.description: A Secret Service agent in Florida and two others were arrested in connection to a brutal, dayslong college hazing ritual that nearly ended in a victim’s death, officials said Sunday.
